name: deckhq
description: Every AI coding session on your machine, on one office floor — in a VS Code panel. Local, private, no telemetry.
author: Darshak Panseriya

untrustedWorkspaces.description: DeckHQ can start a local daemon. The command it runs is read from your user settings only, never from a workspace.

deckhq.port.markdownDescription: The loopback port the DeckHQ daemon listens on. `0` scans `4317`–`4326`, which is the range the daemon itself walks. Nothing outside `127.0.0.1` is ever contacted.

deckhq.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start a DeckHQ daemon when none is already running. Turn this off to use the extension only with a daemon you start yourself.

deckhq.startCommand.markdownDescription: The command that starts the daemon, as an argument list — never a shell string. `--no-open` is added if it is missing, and `--port` is added when `#deckhq.port#` is set. **Read from your user settings only**: a workspace cannot change what this extension runs.

deckhq.statusBar.markdownDescription: Show `▣ 3 waiting · 1 hand up` in the status bar. Click it to open the floor.
